---
title: "Contact"
description: "Tell me about your project. A short note is enough to start."
page-layout: full
---

Working with **single-cell or antibody data**, or looking to bring your data, cloud, and analysis together on **Azure, AWS, or Databricks**? Tell me about it below. You do not need every detail; reasonable estimates are fine. I read every request and reply by email, usually within a few business days.

```{=html}
<style>
.contact-wrap { max-width: 760px; }
.contact-wrap .form-label { font-weight: 600; }
.contact-wrap .optional { font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.65; font-size: 0.85rem; }
.contact-wrap .form-text { opacity: 0.8; }
.contact-wrap .row-2 {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
  gap: 1rem;
}
.contact-wrap .contact-privacy {
  font-size: 0.88rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
  opacity: 0.85;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--bs-primary, #356b8c);
  padding-left: 0.9rem;
  margin: 1.25rem 0;
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .contact-wrap .row-2 { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}
</style>

<div class="contact-wrap">
<form id="service-request-form"
      action="https://formsubmit.co/sridhara.omics@gmail.com"
      method="POST">

<input type="hidden" name="_subject" id="email_subject" value="New consulting inquiry">
<input type="hidden" name="_template" value="table">

<!-- Spam-prevention honeypot -->
<input type="text" name="_honey" tabindex="-1" autocomplete="off" style="display:none">

<div class="row-2 mb-3">
  <div>
    <label for="name" class="form-label">Your name</label>
    <input id="name" name="name" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="name" required>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="email" class="form-label">Email address</label>
    <input id="email" name="email" type="email" class="form-control" autocomplete="email" required>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="mb-3">
  <label for="organization" class="form-label">Organization <span class="optional">(optional)</span></label>
  <input id="organization" name="organization" type="text" class="form-control" autocomplete="organization">
</div>

<div class="row-2 mb-3">
  <div>
    <label for="need" class="form-label">What do you need help with?</label>
    <select id="need" name="need" class="form-select" required>
      <option value="" selected disabled>Select the closest match</option>
      <option value="Cloud data platform (Azure / AWS / Databricks)">Cloud data platform (Azure / AWS / Databricks)</option>
      <option value="Analysis pipeline (single-cell or antibody)">Analysis pipeline (single-cell or antibody)</option>
      <option value="Custom single-cell or antibody analysis">Custom single-cell or antibody analysis</option>
      <option value="Applied AI / adapting an existing model">Applied AI / adapting an existing model</option>
      <option value="Short engagement (review or sprint)">Short engagement (review or sprint)</option>
      <option value="Not sure yet">Not sure yet</option>
    </select>
  </div>
  <div>
    <label for="data_type" class="form-label">Primary data type</label>
    <select id="data_type" name="data_type" class="form-select" required>
      <option value="" selected disabled>Select the closest match</option>
      <option value="Single-cell data">Single-cell data</option>
      <option value="Antibody sequencing / repertoire">Antibody sequencing / repertoire</option>
      <option value="Single-cell and antibody data">Single-cell and antibody data</option>
      <option value="Other data (platform work)">Other data (platform work)</option>
    </select>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="form-text mb-3">
  Analysis and pipeline work focuses on single-cell and antibody data. Cloud platform work can involve other kinds of data, so choose "Other data" in that case.
</div>

<div class="mb-3">
  <label for="analysis" class="form-label">In one line, what do you need?</label>
  <input id="analysis" name="analysis" type="text" class="form-control" maxlength="100"
         placeholder="Bring our single-cell data and notebooks together on Azure" required>
  <div class="form-text">Maximum 100 characters. This goes in the email subject.</div>
</div>

<div class="mb-3">
  <label for="description" class="form-label">Tell me more</label>
  <textarea id="description" name="description" class="form-control" rows="6"
            minlength="50" maxlength="1500"
            placeholder="Your goals, what you have today, the tools or cloud you use, expected outputs, timeline, and any constraints."
            required></textarea>
  <div class="form-text">At least 50 characters.</div>
</div>

<div class="mb-3">
  <label for="datasets_size" class="form-label">Datasets and approximate size <span class="optional">(optional)</span></label>
  <textarea id="datasets_size" name="datasets_size" class="form-control" rows="2" maxlength="1000"
            placeholder="Public accession or link, number of samples, file types, and rough size (e.g. 20 GB or 3 TB)."></textarea>
</div>

<div class="mb-3">
  <label for="timeline" class="form-label">Timeline <span class="optional">(optional)</span></label>
  <select id="timeline" name="timeline" class="form-select">
    <option value="" selected>Select one</option>
    <option value="Just exploring">Just exploring</option>
    <option value="Within 1 month">Within 1 month</option>
    <option value="1 to 3 months">1 to 3 months</option>
    <option value="Flexible">Flexible</option>
  </select>
</div>

<p class="contact-privacy">
  Please share project metadata only. Do not include patient-identifiable information, credentials, confidential data, or proprietary sequences. Your details are used only to reply to your request.
</p>

<button type="submit" class="btn btn-primary">Send request</button>

</form>
</div>

<script>
document.getElementById("service-request-form")
  .addEventListener("submit", function () {
    var name = document.getElementById("name").value.trim();
    var analysis = document.getElementById("analysis").value.trim();
    document.getElementById("email_subject").value =
      "Consulting inquiry - " + name + " - " + analysis;
});
</script>
```
